birth.tz_expect: Pacific/Honolulu — Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time is UTC-10 and NEVER observes DST (the no-DST US-zone control). Engines that reflexively apply US daylight-saving rules to a US location will shift this instant an hour wrong; the correct handling is: no shift, ever. 11:47 HST = 21:47 UTC.

arrived.presenting: in a graduate program where they are constantly evaluated; can produce endlessly but cannot be seen without bracing; wants to stop performing a version of themself that they hope will be approved of
arrived.in_her_words: I have written forty pages about my work and not one true sentence about how I actually am. I noticed that, and it scared me, so I'm here.

beliefs: if they see the real me, they'll withdraw
I have to be exceptional to be allowed to exist here
protections: intellectualizing — analyzing the feeling instead of feeling it
over-producing so the work stands where they won't
curating a self that is impressive but unreachable
patterns: hiding in competence; excelling as camouflage
deflecting warmth, accepting only praise for output
writing endlessly around the truth instead of at it
resources: their notebooks — years of them, where the truest thinking actually happens
a fierce honesty on the page once they let themselves reach it
one advisor and one friend who see them clearly and haven't flinched
psyche.origin: a bright kid praised for output and quietly overlooked as a person; learned that being impressive got them close to people and being ordinary got them left alone — so they became indispensable and unseeable at once

unaware_of: that the over-producing is not-enoughness wearing the mask of excellence
that they hide most from the people who have already stayed

beats.note: arrives with a beautifully written self-analysis that says nothing about how they feel; names the noticing
distinguishes, in a long essay, between being admired and being seen; realizes they have only ever aimed for the first
traces the not-enoughness under the unsafe-to-be-seen — the exceptionalism is a permission slip to exist
shares an unpolished, unedited entry on purpose; reports it as the most exposed they've felt and no one withdrew
lets the friend read the messy notebook page; the belief 'if they see the real me they'll leave' meets counter-evidence
catches the intellectualizing in real time and chooses to stay in the feeling instead — a new move
'being visible is being exposed' beginning to LOOSEN; they write one true sentence about how they are, first, before the analysis

voice: long, reflective, essayistic — they think in paragraphs and metaphor, circle a feeling three times before landing it, footnote their own footnotes; luminous when they finally stop analyzing and simply say the plain thing
